content.en: Poverty estimation in India has evolved from simple **calorie-based intake** models to more comprehensive **multidimensional consumption expenditure** frameworks. Early committees focused on minimum nutritional requirements, while later committees incorporated health and education expenditures.
content.hi: Poverty estimation in India has evolved from simple **calorie-based intake** models to more comprehensive **multidimensional consumption expenditure** frameworks. Early committees focused on minimum nutritional requirements, while later committees incorporated health and education expenditures.
